end.parentNote: Asha practised choosing between exact and approximate values and rounding Indian-number-system values. Ayaan used the digit to the right of the target place and corrected the crore example to 9 crore after noticing that 6 is greater than 5. At home, ask them to round a few amounts to the nearest lakh and crore, explaining which digit decides the answer.
